project_records = [rec for rec in LEGACY_RECORDS if rec['source'].endswith('project.csv') and rec['values']]
if len(project_records) != 110:
    raise ValueError(f'Expected 110 projects, found {len(project_records)}')
project_ids = []
capital = {}
npv = {}
for rec in project_records:
    pid = int(rec['values']['Project ID'])
    project_ids.append(pid)
    capital[pid] = int(rec['values']['Capital (k$)'])
    npv[pid] = int(rec['values']['NPV (k$)'])
m = gp.Model('ProjectSelection')
x_vars = m.addVars(project_ids, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name='')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((npv[pid] * x_vars[pid] for pid in project_ids)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((capital[pid] * x_vars[pid] for pid in project_ids)) <= 1000, name='budget')
m.addConstr(x_vars[4] + x_vars[7] <= 1, name='mutual_4_7')
m.addConstr(x_vars[6] <= x_vars[1], name='prereq_6_1')
m.addConstr(x_vars[10] <= x_vars[5], name='contingent_10_5')
m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')

        print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
